faqs.q: Can Myntmore help Chennai auto-component makers win export buyers in Germany and the US?
faqs.a: Yes. We have booked verified RFQ and sample-evaluation meetings in Germany and other international markets for Indian industrial and engineering component manufacturers.

faqs.q: How do you reach the right commodity buyer inside a huge global Tier-1 or OEM?
faqs.a: We map specific commodity titles (such as Commodity Manager Castings, Global Sourcing Director Machined Parts, or Supplier Development Lead) rather than messaging generic company info addresses.

faqs.q: Can we target EV startups and off-highway OEMs alongside traditional automakers?
faqs.a: Yes. Diversifying into EV powertrains, agricultural machinery, construction equipment, and industrial hydraulics is a proven outbound play we build for Chennai precision manufacturers.

faqs.q: Do you handle NDAs and technical drawing follow-ups?
faqs.a: Our team qualifies buyer interest and hands warm drawing or RFQ requests straight to your engineering and BD team with full conversation context.

faqs.q: Does Myntmore have an office in Chennai?
faqs.a: Our headquarters is in BKC, Mumbai, and we run remote outbound programs for Chennai manufacturers with dedicated strategists and weekly pipeline reviews.
